proposals.evidence: DEDR3613 explicitly attests Gondi narka/naẖka night and Gadaba narkam/narkā/narkām night, explaining internal *nalk > *naṟk sandhi. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5548 gives Telugu vēṟu different/other and vevvēṟu separate/distinct, Konda vēRe vēRe differently/separately, and Gondi vēre separately. Survey Gadaba verevere different has that reduplicated other/separate stem; reduplication is ordinary emphasis/distribution, not a second etymological component. Local contact is possible but an immediate donor is not established. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
